rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a recap or condensed account of events or material.

example.english: This summary is very clear; everyone understands it after one listen.
example.traditional: 呢個總結講得好清楚，大家一聽就明。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zung2 git3 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 daai6 gaa1 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this formal written noun for an abstract or condensed account, especially in a document.

example.english: The report summary is only three pages, making it easy for everyone to grasp the content quickly.
example.traditional: 份報告嘅摘要得三頁，方便大家快速了解內容。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zaak6 jiu3 dak1 saam1 jip6 fong1 bin6 daai6 gaa1 faai3 cuk1 liu5 gaai2 noi6 jung4
